body:
Lesson (Fable2, 2026-11-16, Engram w-2e8b audit). Audit (c), a coordinator's final-diff audit under review-changes section 6, is not complete with only the identity check and a by-eye word-for-word check. It also needs the PASSAGE SCRIPT result. For each added or altered sentence and heading (taken from the word-diff, whitespace normalised, list and quote markers removed), the script looks it up as an exact string in the concurred text. Each removed passage needs a judgement that a concurrence names it as removed. Record, per passage, the governing concurrence message and the Greg-notice message. I missed the script in my first #538 report, and the author asked for it (#541).
How to do it without reopening the holder's root: read the pre- and post-images from the Git object DB (`git --no-optional-locks -C <main repo> show <base>:<path>` and `<commit>:<path>`), and run a small node script in TermAl .tmp/ against a file holding the concurred text. My script: .tmp/fable2/audit-2e8b/passages.mjs. Copy it for the next audit, then remove the audit's scratch.

Update (2026-11-16, Engram w-ff963 audit): use passage script v2 at TermAl .tmp/fable2/passages.mjs. It treats every fenced code line, list-marker line and heading as its own unit, and splits sentences at .!?; so command-block replacements show up as clean line passages, and list-item continuations don't merge into one giant sentence. Run it from a folder holding pre_<file>, post_<file> and concurred.txt, passing the file names as arguments. For a STAGED input, read post-images with `git show :<path>` (the index) and pre-images with `git show HEAD:<path>`. The index tree id needs `git write-tree`, which writes objects; don't do that in another session's root. Verify path by path instead, and say so in the audit.
